name: a sale that leaves a coin worth less than the broker's smallest order writes the rest off with it, and the trade closes
spec: SPEC.md §2 Trade: a coin is flat once what is left of it is dust

the 0.05 is written off with t2 at nothing: 0 - 0.05 x 10 = -0.50, realized 2026-02-02
the coin is flat on 2026-02-02: one trade, opened by t1, 10 units, closed 2026-02-02, P&L 19.90 - 0.50 = 19.40
no position; no unit went beyond what the book held
